selector.meaning: API-provided format selector; not a player ordinal or a proven reference component index.

cursor_arithmetic.interpretation: Manual arithmetic verified against complete receiver instructions and exact pins, not runtime execution or a packet decoder.

id_resolution.caution: No general membership guarantee: helper can return sentinel, and a no-entry path can dereference zero. BC2D30 does not validate output before selected receivers. Creation ordering alone does not prove all callers are safe.

modification_implications: The selected format carries one entity, not an inline array of four players; no four-player count patch is identified in this dispatcher.
Its component41/238/239 receivers index destination arrays by entity-map ordinal. Existing four-row native storage still requires independent expansion.
Direct owner+4148, owner+E9FC98, owner+EA0818 aliases must move if the owning embedded systems relocate; changing global pointers alone is insufficient.
Four-byte scalar strides and selector maximum73E are not player limits.
Eight-player use of unchanged one-entity schema is a conditional design possibility, not a verified sender/API/transport capability.
limits: Fixed saved capture only; no process query/read, new capture, game patch, multiplayer run or runtime metadata verification.
Six selected receivers and five direct incoming edges are scoped evidence; no exhaustive classification of BC2D30 other cases.

No selected-path input length or entity-ID validity guard was established. API production of payload and selector remains unresolved.
